description: s441 fix round (review:S441-f4f5-review). An inline handler chains `.then` on a server call. Since s441 the handler awaits the call for you, so the emitted `(await isOk(1)).then(…)` reads `.then` off the resolved boolean — a TypeError at run time, silently breaking code that previously worked on the Promise. It is now a compile error naming the fix (drop `.then`; the call is awaited).
rationale: §13.2: a call the compiler awaits yields the resolved value; reading `.then`/`.catch`/`.finally` off it SHALL be a compile error (E-ASYNC-CALL-PROMISE-METHOD, §34).
